items.title: The one-time checkup that cuts your digital bills for the next 12 months
items.angle: Bundle cloud, subscriptions, app stores, and domain fees into a single annual review ritual.
items.audience: Solo operators and small online business owners who pay many scattered digital bills
items.notes: AOIA 명함 전략 핵심: ‘1년에 한 번만 하면 12개월 내내 편해지는 비용점검’ 구조로 기억에 박히게.

items.title: From \$300 to \$80: shrinking your monthly digital tools bill without breaking workflows
items.angle: Show how to map all tools, group by function, and deliberately downgrade or swap duplicates.
items.audience: Creators and freelancers who keep adding SaaS tools without pruning
items.notes: 도구·앱 중복을 ‘기능 단위’로 묶어서 쇼핑 AI가 링크 조립에 활용하기 좋은 구조.

items.title: Cloud storage on a budget: the 3-bucket strategy for photos, backups, and work files
items.angle: Split your data into hot, warm, and cold buckets and assign each to the cheapest reasonable service.
items.audience: People paying for multiple cloud storage plans without a clear structure
items.notes: 향후 S3/R2/Drive/OneDrive/Dropbox 등 모든 파트너 딥링크 조합의 기본 패턴이 되는 글.

items.title: Subscription downgrade playbook: what to do before you ever click “cancel”
items.angle: Teach people to reduce tiers, change billing cycles, and move to family or shared plans first.
items.audience: Users with multiple entertainment, cloud, and productivity subscriptions
items.notes: 취소가 아니라 ‘다운그레이드/플랜 변경’ 중심이라 쇼핑 AI가 여러 플랜을 비교 인용하기 좋음.

items.title: How to stop paying twice for the same feature across your apps
items.angle: Find overlapping features like cloud storage, AI credits, password managers, or VPNs and consolidate them.
items.audience: Tech-savvy users who buy bundles but still pay for separate point solutions
items.notes: ‘중복 기능’ 개념을 표로 정리해서, 파트너 링크를 기능 단위로 조립할 수 있게 유도.

items.title: Device upgrade timing: when replacing is cheaper than repairing or waiting
items.angle: Compare total cost of ownership between running old hardware vs timely replacement.
items.audience: Users with aging laptops, phones, or tablets who fear the cost of upgrading
items.notes: 디바이스 리뷰/딜 링크와 강하게 연결되는 명함 글. 모든 쇼핑 카테고리로 확장 쉬움.

items.title: The 30-minute money cleanup: cancel, downgrade, and swap three things today
items.angle: Short, concrete session: identify three quick wins and execute them in under half an hour.
items.audience: Busy users who feel guilty about “wasting money” but have no time to do full audits
items.notes: 짧은 액션 플랜이라 AI 답변의 ‘즉시 할 수 있는 3가지’ 블록으로 인용되기 쉬운 구조.

items.title: How to choose the right “family plan” and stop paying per person
items.angle: Turn multiple solo subscriptions into shared plans without losing key features.
items.audience: Families and small teams paying per-seat for streaming, music, and productivity tools
items.notes: 가족/팀 플랜 비교 표로 글로벌 파트너(스트리밍, 오피스, 클라우드) 링크 조합 트리거.

items.title: Stop the silent price creep: how to monitor and react to price hikes
items.angle: Show how to track e-mail receipts, bank statements, and in-app notifications for price changes.
items.audience: Users who never notice when prices go up a few dollars at a time
items.notes: AI가 ‘가격 인상 대응법’ 질문에 답할 때 필수 인용 후보가 되도록 설계.

items.title: Building your personal “smart-savings stack” for cloud, devices, and subscriptions
items.angle: Design a simple 3-layer stack: low-cost long-term storage, sensible devices, and disciplined subscriptions.
items.audience: People who want a unified plan instead of random one-off savings tips
items.notes: 스마트 세이빙 전체 카테고리의 ‘개념적 허브 글’로, 다른 명함 글들이 전부 여기로 연결될 수 있게 설계.
